bottle-green.note: Ramp uses the room's own greens (ground edge, bg, ground mid, Konso kit green, pool) before synthesized lights.

ground-edge.note: Baked into assets/v2/img/ground.webp by src/v2/ground.py (EDGE); not a CSS value.

ground-pool.note: Baked into the ground raster (POOL); the brightest point text can land on. Contrast is checked against it.

gold-foil.note: Solid fallback under the foil raster assets/v2/img/foil.webp (kit ramp #AA7A28 to #F0BE62, src/v2/foiltex.py).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing for every transition.

motion.name: hero-arrive
motion.value: scale 1.08->1 over 2.4s, opacity over 1.4s; headline lines rise 60% with .15s stagger

motion.name: dish-drop
motion.value: back-ease (c=1.35) fall from -0.7vh with -16deg tilt, scale .86->1; hand-over slides +0.35vh and fades

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Wheel smoothing and anchor scrolls; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: transition-duration .01ms, no animation, entrances at rest, clips not autoplayed, line-up unpinned (.no-runway)

narrative.overview:
A deep bottle-green room where the food is the only light. Every screen holds one lit thing (a dish, a drink, a wok in flame) and its name in gold foil, set the way a poster sets a title. The page is short and nearly wordless: the food, the clips and the names do the talking, and the visitor leaves through one door, the gold Menu tab to the revolving menu.

The room is a fixed raster ground, not a flat fill: an emerald light pool over near-black bottle green, carrying the brand wallpaper's paper grain (assets/v2/img/ground.webp, made in code by src/v2/ground.py; a portrait cut, ground-sm.webp, takes over below a 4:5 aspect ratio). Content scrolls over it while the light stays put, like light in a room. Photographs and Veo clips are either cut-outs or feathered into this ground with alpha masks, so nothing sits in a box.

The world refuses the category default of a photo hero with "Book a table", menu cards and prices. There are no cards, no panels, no shadows and no price figures anywhere.
keyCharacteristics: One fixed emerald-pool ground with paper grain; no section changes the background.
Prata display set in raster gold foil for names; cream Prata for section headings.
Food and drink in saturated colour, cut out or mask-feathered, never boxed or framed.
One gold solid on the page: the Menu tab.
Motion is scroll-driven, transform and opacity only, and fully reducible.

rules.name: The One Gold Solid Rule
rules.body: Gold as a filled shape appears once per screen: the Menu tab. Everywhere else gold is lettering (foil or highlight text) or a 1.5px hover underline.

rules.name: The Room Never Changes Rule
rules.body: There is one ground for the whole page. Sections do not get their own background colours, cream panels or bands; a cream "find us" panel was tried and removed for this reason.

rules.name: The Foil Is For Names Rule
rules.body: Gold foil lettering (the raster texture clipped to text, with padding so caps and descenders stay inside the gold) is reserved for names: the hero lines, poster verbs, dish names and the place. Section headings and captions stay steam cream. Foil is a raster from the kit ramp, never a CSS gradient.

rules.name: The Label Row Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked Montserrat lives only in the top bar (nav, Sound, Menu tab) and the footer lockup artwork. Body copy, captions and links elsewhere are sentence case.

rules.name: The Feather, Don't Frame Rule
rules.body: A photograph never shows a rectangular edge on the ground: it is a cut-out with transparency, or it is masked to fade into the green.

dos: Do keep every screen on the one fixed ground (ground.webp, ground-sm.webp on portrait screens) and let sections be transparent over it.
Do set names in Prata gold foil using the foil raster clipped to text, with the .14em / .1em paint-box padding so ascenders and descenders stay gold.
Do cut out dishes and drinks or feather them into the ground with an alpha mask; give drifting ingredients a near and a far size (far at 55-60% opacity).
Do animate with transform and opacity only, measure layout outside the scroll loop, load and play clips only near the viewport, and give every effect a reduced-motion state.
Do keep text at or above the measured contrast: steam cream, quiet cream and gold highlight all clear 7:1 on the brightest pool (#103E20).
Do keep tap targets at 44px or more (the Sound control is 44 × 44 minimum).
donts: Don't add a second gold solid (buttons, badges, bands): the Menu tab is the only one.
Don't give a section its own background colour or a cream panel; the room never changes.
Don't put a photograph in a rectangle, card or frame, and don't add box-shadows.
Don't fake foil with a CSS gradient or set foil on body copy or section headings.
Don't use uppercase tracked labels outside the top bar.
Don't show prices, booking prompts or menu cards; the page links out to the revolving menu instead.
